intent_en: To illustrate the proportion of electricity consumption in California attributed to indoor marijuana cultivation relative to total household usage.
previous_intent: To illustrate the significant proportion of household electricity consumption in California attributed to indoor marijuana cultivation.
narration_support: In California, indoor marijuana grow modules account for about 9 % of household electricity use.
chart_support: Map of California with house icons representing households and a partial arc visualizing a small percentage share.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly links indoor marijuana cultivation to a percentage of household electricity in California. The chart visualizes this by showing a map of California with house icons (households) and a small arc segment (representing the ~9% share).
